answer: Space consequential actions by a mandatory cooldown, not just their magnitude. Each privileged move an identity makes starts a dormancy gap that must elapse on the mesa of real wall-clock before the next one counts; an echo of the same action fired early is simply ignored. Compute cannot compress this interval, so a farm cannot burst a thousand fakes through a right all at once — each identity drips its actions one slow pigment-drop at a time, and the per-identity work cost still applies to every head in parallel.
